description: This Java interface defines configuration settings related to metrics reporting within a health checking context. It includes methods to retrieve metrics resolution duration and history size, along with an internal enum specifying default configuration values and paths.

classes.name: MetricsReporterConfig
classes.description: An interface specifying configuration options for metrics reporting in health checks.

methods.name: getResolution
methods.description: Returns the duration between each measurement measurement.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Returns the number of past measurements to retain.

inner_classes.name: MetricsReporterConfigValue
inner_classes.description: Enumeration of default configuration values and their config paths for MetricsReporterConfig.
